title: Hopf Fibrations on Compact and Noncompact Calabi–Yau Manifolds
content: We characterize compact Calabi–Yau manifolds of complex dimension at least two admitting free isometric or holomorphic circle actions by flat bundles over parallel transverse Calabi–Yau bases. Over a fixed such base, the integral Euler classes are exactly torsion. We construct prime-order examples, classify free unitary linear models and fixed-metric imaginary self-dual flux pairs, and derive normalized curvature and spectral formulas. Genuine noncompact Hopf constructions are given explicitly.
